createdAt.description: The date and time at which the pull request was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the pull request was updated.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user who created the pull request.

updatedBy.description: The ID of the user who last updated the pull request.

comment.description: If the pull request is a `decline` status, an optional comment about why the pull request was declined.

fortkType.description: The type of element the pull request was forked from.

source.description: Information about the pull request's source (parent) element.

destination.description: Information about the pull request destination element.

status.description:
The pull request's current review status:
- `open` — The pull request is still open.
- `approved` — The pull request was approved by its reviewers.
- `declined` — The pull request was not approved by its reviewers.

merge.description: Information about the current progress of the pull request's merge.

reviewers.description: Information about the reviewers assigned to the pull request.

exists.description: If true, whether the element is present and not deleted.

PullRequestGetDestination.description: Information about the pull request destination element.

status.description:
The pull request's current merge status:
- `inactive` — There is no merge in progress.
- `inprogress` — The pull request is currently merging.
- `failed` — The pull request's merge failed.

status.description:

forkName.description: The name of the fork created from the source element.
